title: Utilizing the hydrogen evolution reaction: a bio-inspired pH-sensitive electrolyte for ultra-stable zinc-ion batteries at high temperatures
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, 19,2536-2546
DOI: 10.1039/D6EE00449K, Communication
Fan Bu, Qiwen Wu, Jingzhu Chen, Wenbo Zhao, Yong Gao, Jipeng Chen, Ting Zhang, Yu Zhang, Salah A. Makhlouf, Cao Guan
A bio-inspired pH-sensitive electrolyte utilizes the unwanted HER as an initial high-pH microenvironment and drives the additive into a ZrO2/ZnF2 layer, facilitating practical Zn-ion batteries with superior cycling stability at high temperatures.
